purpose: One fresh synthetic followup after phase-only rejection; determine whether a phase field adds value beyond an explicit witness sidecar
scope: No official data, Linux work, heldout ANN queries, production integration or durable format
block_populations: alternating n and n/4, as the original screen
interior_rare: 32 radius12 coordinate-axis queries. Each owner block contains10 identical true neighbors per query. Remaining rows split evenly between radius3 antithetic shells around own query centers and radius0.75 clouds around preceding-block query centers. At least one antipodal shell pair encloses each true query center. This tests rare neighbors that are not farthest from the block centroid.
witness_selection: Base rows only. First choose the row nearest the block centroid (ID tie break); repeatedly choose the unselected row with greatest squared distance to its nearest selected witness (ID tie break). Hybrid uses the first36 of the same48-point sequence. Store only witness vectors for block routing; no per-witness ID needed at serving time.
routing_rule: At fanout f, reserve ceil(f/2) blocks with the nearest exact witness distance, then fill remaining slots by descending phase score, skipping already selected blocks. Ties use block ID. No learned weights or per-case parameters.
eligibility: At fanout4, every coherent/multimodal/rare/interior_rare case and projection seed has coverage>=0.9975; no case loses more than0.0025 vs the better48-witness/reservoir control; at least one scenario gains>=0.02 mean coverage over BOTH48-witness and reservoir controls. All outcomes retained, no parameter or seed retuning.
budget_stop: If phase storage alone reaches raw vector bytes for any registered case, record that case and do not run an unjustified hybrid comparison. Report stored raw/header/projection/witness bytes.
timing: BLAS2; warmup+5 local exploratory samples; no production performance claim
failure_rule: Stop on correctness or budget failure; retain all results and losses
